test: two-sided standard-normal Wald P; source method must independently support this
rounding_rule: Each decimal source string represents an interval centered on its numeric value with half one unit at its final printed decimal/significant digit. Scientific-notation exponent is respected. Truncated zeros do not create spurious precision. Bounds are propagated through log(OR), SE division, and two-sided normal survival function. P interval must intersect the propagated interval.
risk_direction: assign only if OR rounding interval excludes 1, signed source semantics and row QC pass; OR=1/ambiguous/invalid remain unresolved
deterministic_sample: First 250 rows per chromosome x P band (>=0.05; [5e-8,0.05); [1e-12,5e-8); <1e-12), plus every 1000th source row, plus all significant rows. Whole-file interval test also required.
locus_definition: autosomal source P<5e-8; plus/minus 1500000 bp; native GRCh37 chromosome-clipped; transitive overlap merge; whole intersecting chr6:25000000-36000000 merged interval deferred; deterministic ties P, chromosome, position, exact alleles, source row
duplicates: preserve all; exact duplicates flagged, conflicts block contrast; no silent deduplication
reference_requirement: Source effect/other alleles do not imply REF/ALT; GRCh37 reference normalization independently required. Harmonized Catalog file is GRCh38 and cannot silently replace native coordinates.
